answer: Require each new agent to wander a bridge of small paid tasks before it may draw from the shared vault: every crossing demands a unique, verifiable proof of work tied to a single identity, and the vault releases rewards only after peers attest the work. A genuine agent pays that small cost once, but a Sybil operator must pay it for every fake identity, so fielding a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand proofs and the attack stops paying for itself.
